See the [monorepo CHANGELOG](https://github.com/rajkishorsahu89/doc-preview/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#112--2026-06-03) for full **1.1.2** release notes.

## 1.1.1 — 2026-06-02

- PPTX animation step-through, SmartArt embedded image fallback, chart 3D / raster improvements
- `extractOdtComparableBlocks()` for layout-aware ODT compare
- Enterprise in-document search on PPTX/ODP decks, ODT, and XLSX/ODS spreadsheets
- Deck slide sync events for split-view (`dp-pptx-slide-change` / `dp-pptx-goto-slide`)

See the [monorepo CHANGELOG](https://github.com/rajkishorsahu89/doc-preview/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#111--2026-06-02) for full **1.1.1** release notes.

## 1.1.0 — 2026-06-01

### PPTX / ODP slide deck

- Positioned slide canvas — shapes with fills, borders, connector lines, and combined shape+text elements
- Theme colors, bullets, vertical text alignment, paragraph spacing, and `normAutofit` text scaling inside shapes
- Solid, gradient, and image slide backgrounds; readable text on dark slides
- Deck toolbar — compact nav, jump-to-slide, thumbnail strip, fit/zoom, speaker notes panel
- **Presenter view** — slide beside speaker notes when notes exist in the file
- **Export** — current slide PNG, all slides as ZIP (PNG per slide), or all slides as one PDF (`pdf-lib`)
- Keyboard navigation — arrow keys, Home / End, space for next slide
- Exported APIs — `renderPresentationDeck`, `buildPptxSlideCanvas`, `exportElementToPngBlob`, `downloadPngBlob`, `exportAllSlidesAsPngZip`, `exportAllSlidesAsPdf`
- Plain-text extractors — `extractPptxPlainText`, `extractOdpPlainText`

See the [monorepo CHANGELOG](https://github.com/rajkishorsahu89/doc-preview/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#110--2026-06-01) for full 1.1.0 release notes.
